answer: Give every agent a waypoint-stamped journey bond before it can trade. First, it locks 50 tokens for 90 days and gets a blank travel log it cannot forge. Second, independent checkpoints stamp the log only after real, paid work, with a falcon-style audit scanning each stamp for duplicates. Third, at 12 stamps it trades freely; cheating forfeits the bond and drops it to its nadir, locked out of the market for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $500,000 in bonds and needs 120,000 verified jobs and earns nothing back. It works like a passport that only fills up by traveling.
